services.name: Maha’ulepu Scenic Ocean, Mountain, Valley Ride
services.desc: Maha’ulepu Scenic Ocean, Mountain, Valley Ride Duration 2 Hours Availability Tuesday-Friday 9:30am and 2:00pm (check in is 30 minutes before your ride starts!) About This scenic journey, offered twice daily, takes you through the historic Maha‘ulelpu coastline. You’ll experience a variety of scenery and terrain from coastal and mountain vistas to agricultural ranch land. View native plants and wildlife all while enjoying some of the most beautiful panoramic ocean, mountain and valley views on the south shore of Kauai What to wear and bring: Covered/Closed toe shoes Long Pants are recommended, but shorts, capris and leggings are acceptable Sunscreen Small Camera, NO SELFIE STICKS PLEASE!

services.name: Team Rope / Breakaway in Paradise
services.desc: This excursion is perfect for the vacationing experienced Roper who needs a quick Roping fix! Come hang out with the owner & Ohana! Jimmy Miranda is a 4th generation Paniolo, (Hawaiian Cowboy). Jimmy was born and raised on Kukaiau Ranch wich was established in 1885 on the Island of Hawaii (Big Island). He holds many championship titles from Team Roping, Bull Riding, Saddle Bronc and Barrel Racing just to name a few. This excursion includes one hour practice session in our rodeo arena on live steers and the hot heels. Plan on being at the ranch for at least two hours.
